goal: Password credentials use Argon2id by default with rotation and disable, and first-slice collaboration-task types fully manage agent-team work from the channel
scenarios: a new password is stored as an Argon2id hash with salt and parameters
an existing PBKDF2 or bcrypt hash still verifies
a user rotates their password and the old hash no longer works
a disabled credential cannot log in
a channel message creates a collaboration task with requester, assignee, objective, skills, tools, and context tags
accept, decline, question, answer, transfer, block, unblock, complete, and cancel update the task and write an event
a transfer names sending role, receiving role, reason, context, next action, required evidence, and unresolved questions
an agent run refuses a collaboration task that is missing required fields
the developer board shows open collaboration tasks and customers cannot manage them
constraints: only salted hashes and algorithm parameters are stored
passwords, OAuth secrets, API tokens, and raw session secrets are never logged
creating a collaboration task does not create a dsh LLM chat task
